name: K
source:
"Look. My actions shouldn't concern you, or anyone for that matter. I'm only trying to help you, but if you don't want to listen, then fine. Get yourself killed."

From the start, K marks herself as somewhat more suspicious by refusing to share a single detail of her identity. Quiet and mysterious, she makes it clear that, while she doesn't stand against the other fourteen victims, she doesn't necessarily consider herself their ally either.

Her confident, sarcastic personality begins to show as she is forced to interact more closely with those around her, though she remains serious and stony throughout. Blunt and to-the-point, she won't hesitate to share her opinion if she finds it to be necessary, regardless of how the others might react, and due to her differing values and focus on the situation, she prefers to work alone whenever possible.

Her intelligence, combined with her sharp eye and attention to detail, allows her to piece things together very quickly, even while everyone else struggles to do so.
